title: Supermarket Fridge Hacks Signal a Wider Cyber Threat
gist: Cyberattacks that remotely raised temperatures in supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe forced retailers to discard food, and UK NCSC head Richard Horne warned more such incidents are likely due to ageing, underinvested operational technology. The NCSC says an AI-powered ransomware attack on British critical infrastructure is highly likely by 2028.
